comparison.objective: Peel the correct day label and adhere it flat to a food-tub lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-tab pinching, controlled peeling, compliant placement, and progressive adhesive pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Correct label wholly on the lid with all quarters adhered and released; wrong-label disturbance, folding, or tub displacement fails.
comparison.reason: Adhesive-sheet peeling and placement are meaningfully different from screening free rigid media through apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.
